title: Accelerated protocol for the differentiation of podocytes from human pluripotent stem cells
protocol: Prepare Geltrex or Matrigel coated plates.
Transfer 5 mL of warmed mTeSR media into a 15 mL tube.
Thaw a frozen vial of hiPSC in a 37°C water bath with gentle shaking until the ice starts to melt.
Transfer thawed hiPSCs drop-wise into the 15 mL conical tube containing 5 ml prewarmed media.
Gently rotate the tube to mix cells with media.
Centrifuge the cells for 5 min at 300 × g at room temperature.
Remove supernatant and add 3 mL of fresh iPSC passage media.
Seed cells onto plates coated with Geltrex or Matrigel.
Distribute cells evenly by rocking plate back and forth gently.
Incubate cells at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator for 24 h.
Change iPSC passage media to regular mTeSR media after 24 h.
Change the media every day.
Remove media from the hiPSCs in the 6-well plate.
Wash cells with 3 mL of PBS three times.
Aspirate PBS.
Add 1 mL per well of Accutase to cells and incubate at 37°C for 5 min.
Add 2 mL per well of warm mTeSR to the cells, mix, and ensure cells have lifted off from the plastic surface.
Collect cells in a 15 mL tube.
Count cell number using a hemocytometer.
Calculate the required volume to achieve 1.5 × 10^6 iPSC per well of the 6-well plate.
Aliquot the iPSC to be plated into a 15 mL tube.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant.
Gently resuspend the cells in iPSC passage media.
Seed the cells onto the Geltrex or Matrigel coated plates.
Rock the plate back and forth to distribute cells evenly.
Incubate at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator for 24 h.
Rinse the cells 3 times with PBS.
Add 1 mL of Accutase per 6-well plate.
Incubate the cells at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 5 min or until the cells start to detach.
If necessary, incubate for 2-3 more minutes if the cells do not start to detach.
Add 3 mL of fresh mTeSR media to the dissociated cells, mix thoroughly.
Ensure cells have lifted off from the plastic surface.
Collect cells in a 15 mL tube.
Count the cell number using a hemocytometer.
Centrifuge the cells for 5 min at 300 × g at room temperature.
Remove the supernatant and gently resuspend 2×10^6 cells per mL of cryopreservation medium consisting of 90% FBS and 10% DMSO.
Add 1 mL of cell suspension per cryopreservation tube.
Place the tubes into a cryovial freezer box and freeze at -80°C for 24 h.
Transfer the tubes to a liquid nitrogen cell storage tank for long-term cryopreservation.
Remove the supernatant from the cells.
Gently resuspend the cells in iPSC passage media.
Seed the cells on Geltrex/Matrigel plates.
Rock the plates back and forth to ensure even distribution of cells.
Incubate at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator for 24 hours.
Aspirate the iPSC passage media from cells.
Prepare primitive streak induction media.
Add 2 mL of primitive streak media per well of a 12-well plate.
Culture the cells in primitive streak media for 2 days without changing the media.
Aspirate the primitive streak media from the cells.
Prepare intermediate mesoderm induction media.
Add 2 mL of intermediate mesoderm media per 12-well plate.
Refresh medium every day.
Let the induction of mesoderm continue until day 5.
Aspirate the medium from the intermediate mesoderm cells.
Incubate with 2 mL per 12-well plate of nephron progenitor medium.
Culture cells in nephron progenitor medium for 2 days.
Refresh medium daily.
Remove the intermediate mesoderm differentiation medium from cells and wash cells one time with PBS.
Add Accutase (0.5 mL per well for 12-well plates) to cells and incubate for 5 min at 37°C.
Visualize cells under the microscope to ensure the cells are properly dissociated into either individual cells or small clumps.
Pipette the cells gently 3 times and transfer the cells to a 15 mL tube.
Add fresh nephron progenitor media to the tube to quench the Accutase.
Centrifuge cells at 300 × g for 5 min and aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells with podocyte induction media at a 1:4 dilution ratio to plate 2.5 × 10^5 cells per well of a laminin-511-coated 12-well plate.
Change the podocyte induction media daily.
Remove the media from the podocytes and wash the cells with PBS twice.
Fix the cells in 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS by adding 1 mL per well of a 12-well plate for 15 min.
Wash the cells with PBS twice.
Block the samples by adding 1 mL per well of 12-well plate in PBS-BT for 30 min.
Stain with the desired primary antibodies diluted in 2% BSA for either 4 h at room temperature (RT) or 24 h at 4°C.
Wash the cells with 500 μL PBS per well of 12-well plate twice by aspirating and adding fresh PBS.
Incubate the cells with the corresponding secondary antibody.
Stain the nuclei with DAPI diluted 1:1000 in PBS for 5 min and visualize using a fluorescent microscope.
Remove the media from the podocytes and wash the cells with PBS twice.
Add 1 mL of 0.05% trypsin per well of 12-well plates and incubate at 37°C for 5 min.
Add 2 mL of warm DMEM/F12 to the cells, mix, and ensure cells have lifted off from the plastic surface.
Collect cells in a 15 mL tube and centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min.
Wash the cells with 1 mL of PBS twice.
Aspirate PBS.
Fix the cells in 1 mL of 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS for 15 min.
Wash the cells with 500 μL of 2% BSA twice by centrifugation at 400 × g for 2 min after each wash.
Remove the supernatant.
Permeabilize the cells with 100% cold ethanol for 10 min at 4°C.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 2 min.
Remove the supernatant and wash the cells with 2% BSA twice with centrifugation.
Block the samples by adding 1 mL of 5% BSA in PBS for 30 min.
Centrifuge briefly at 400 × g for 2 min.
Wash the cells with 2% BSA twice with centrifugation.
Remove the supernatant.
Stain with the desired primary antibodies (200 μL) diluted in 2% BSA for either 4 h at RT or 24 h at 4°C.
Wash with 2% BSA and aspirate the supernatant.
Incubate the cells with 200 μL of the corresponding secondary antibody diluted in 2% BSA for 2 h at RT or for 24 h at 4°C.
Wash with PBS twice.
Resuspend the cells in 200 μL PBS.
Analyze the cells using a flow cytometer and compare to the negative isotype controls using FlowJo software.
Remove the media from the podocytes.
Incubate podocytes with podocyte induction medium for 24 hours.
Wash cells twice with PBS by aspirating and replacing with fresh PBS.
Add 50 μg/mL FITC-conjugated bovine serum to podocytes for 1 hour at 4°C.
Alternatively, add 50 μg/mL FITC-conjugated bovine serum to podocytes for 24 hours at 37°C.
Visualize endocytosis with a fluorescent microscope.
